logline: 竹澗有聲音，和也有聲音。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 竹澗聽和 — Slow Mandarin Jazz

comics.en: A brook does not hurry around the stone.
Shared shade is already an answer.
Two winds meet and neither wins.
Sit until the birds answer each other.
